key_highlights: ASX posts fourth consecutive losing week as bond yields climb, pressuring equities across sectors
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite sharp unemployment jump, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences sharp depreciation ('trapdoor opens'), raising import costs and commodity-linked equity volatility
House prices over halfway to largest 40-year decline, with Victoria hit hardest by unemployment
$2.7B cap raise torrent pressures small/mid-cap ASX listings; gold explorers (Aurum, Zenith, Auric, Kuniko) see strong assay results
Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming/consumer discretionary
Data centre energy demand boom raises structural power supply concerns for ASX energy names

sectors.trend: Gold explorers (Aurum, Zenith, Auric, Kuniko) post strong assay hits; Rio2 launches Peruvian copper drill; $2.7B cap raise wave pressures small-caps. Gold strength offsets broad commodity softness.
sectors.implications: Selective upside in gold juniors; large-caps (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face headwinds from AUD weakness and global demand concerns. Cap raises dilute small-cap holders.

sectors.trend: RBA hiking cycle continues despite unemployment spike; rate pincer squeezes household balance sheets. NIMs supported but credit growth at risk as renters struggle.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher yields short-term but face rising NPLs as unemployment climbs. Bond yield climb pressures bank valuations.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom drives structural power demand; energy supply constraints flagged. Sydney Water payroll issues signal operational stress in utilities.
sectors.implications: AGL.AX, CSG.AX, INC.AX benefit from sustained demand; watch for policy intervention on data centre energy pricing.

sectors.trend: House prices in 40-year decline; Star casino licence suspended; solo parent penalty and renter stress weigh on consumer spending. Property listings (CBD tower $40m) signal softening.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and yield pressure. WES.AX, WBC.AX consumer exposure under pressure. Star (SGH.AX) remains impaired.

sectors.trend: AI adoption accelerating in Australian SMEs; Medicare data breach prompts AI safety legislation. CSL.AX stable but sector lacks catalyst.
sectors.implications: Local tech names limited on ASX; global AI chip trade (Nvidia, AMD) drives sentiment. CSL.AX, SXW.AX remain defensive anchors.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot vs rising unemployment – policy dilemma
AUD depreciation as import-cost and capital-flow risk
Housing market correction accelerating, especially Victoria
Gold exploration activity robust; cap raise dilution risk for small-caps
Energy demand structural shift from data centres
Household financial stress: renters, solo parents, rate pincer

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA continued hikes amid rising unemployment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight rate-sensitive defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX); underweight rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) whose revenue is USD-denominated
Reduce REIT and construction exposure; monitor GPT and VPT for further downgrades
Shorten duration in fixed income; favour quality dividend payers with low beta
Avoid pre-announcement small-caps; favour cash-flow-positive juniors with limited dilution history
Maintain commodity hedges; monitor energy and defence-linked equities

opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6, Auric Munda) signal sector-wide gold strength; AUD weakness boosts AUD-denominated gold equities

opportunities.recommendation: Add large-cap diversified miners for AUD hedge
opportunities.rationale: USD revenue streams offset AUD depreciation; BHP and RioTinto provide defensive yield in volatile tape

opportunities.recommendation: Position in energy generators ahead of data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural power demand from data centres supports pricing; AGL and Origin benefit from sustained load growth

defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price decline underway; renter stress and falling valuations pressure occupancy and distributions

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim growth/tech exposure; rotate to quality dividend defensives
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising bond yields compress growth multiples; CSL and Wesfarmers offer lower beta and stable cash flows

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid small-cap cap-raise names without cash flow
defensive_moves.rationale: $2.7B cap raise wave dilutes shareholders; only fund proven, cash-generative explorers

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to extend losses in 5th week as RBA hawkishness, rising bond yields, and AUD weakness dominate. Gold miners and large-cap diversified miners outperform. REITs and small-caps under pressure. Volatility elevated.
market_outlook.long_term: If RBA peaks and unemployment stabilises, equities recover within 6–12 months. Housing correction may deepen before stabilising. Gold and energy remain structural themes. AI adoption in Australian SMEs supports long-term productivity but near-term capex is concentrated offshore.
